result.summary: Adjudicated CLM-018 (read-only). Verdict: CLOSE_WITH_INTERIM_REGISTRY — the task can close before DAT-003 without faking its complete manifest. Exploration corrected the briefing: the free-access-vs-reuse prose distinction ALREADY EXISTS across footer, about, licensing, terms, api-docs, JSON-LD (isAccessibleForFree:true + license→/licensing), and CITATION.cff (which correctly omits a single SPDX license). The one true blocking finding is a code-license overclaim — README.md:223 'MIT-licensed', about.md:57 'open-source', and the licensing 'Repository license' row assert a code license while NO root LICENSE file exists. Recommended fix (A): correct wording to 'source-visible, not yet released under an open-source license,' keeping CLM-018 self-contained and deferring the license choice to BRD-007/008; alternative (B) adds a root LICENSE now (pulls BRD-007/008 forward) — flagged as the single owner decision. Binding contract is REUSE-FIRST: extend the existing claims machinery rather than build a parallel system — register reuse claims as PublicClaim rows (institutional-posture tier, whose prohibitedLanguage already bans implying openness), add typed src/lib/claims/reuse-rights.ts mirroring seed-sources.ts plus CODE_RIGHTS(hasLicenseFile:false), RELEASE_MANIFEST_STATUS(available:false, owner:DAT-003) and IS_COMPLETE_MANIFEST:false so /licensing SOURCE_ROWS resolve from it and nothing reads as DAT-003's complete manifest. New fail-closed scripts/validate-rights-claims.ts (shaped like validate-policy-surface.ts) registered as a child check in claims-docs-gate.ts catches blanket-data-open, code-license overclaim, silent required surface (embed/cite/download must point to /licensing), and false 'complete rights manifest exists', with negative fixtures per class + a seeded gate fixture. Point-of-use gaps: embed route and CiteAccordion need /licensing pointers ('citation is not a license'). Deferred: DAT-003 (complete field/product/release manifest) and BRD-007/008 (actual code-license decision + root LICENSE).
